Eddie Brock is the confirmed human traveler returning to the Sony-side continuity context. This does not collapse Eddie with the Venom symbiote.
Director Daniel Espinosa explicitly identifies Michael Keaton's Morbius Vulture as the same Adrian Toomes from Spider-Man: Homecoming rather than a multiversal variant.

Monica Rambeau is the traveler shown awakening in the alternate-universe context in The Marvels; this fact does not identify Binary or Beast as travelers and does not assert a connection to Doomsday return variants.
